pie_de_post: Where are you traveling next? Save this for that trip and follow.

slides.etiqueta: I travel a lot and never lose my physique: here's my protocol

slides.texto:
3 sessions of 30–45 minutes: hotel, local gym or bodyweight.
Maintaining costs far less than building.

At every meal, protein and vegetables first. Then everything else.
At the buffet: first plate is protein, always.

Explore on foot. You'll hit 10–15k steps a day without noticing.
The best way to see a city and not gain fat.

Morning sunlight at your destination, meals on local time and no long naps on day one.
Your body clock adjusts faster.

2–3 free meals a week, guilt-free.
One trip won't ruin you. A year without a system will.

slides.etiqueta: Live. Travel. Keep what you built.
